ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why variance is real and one losing month proves nothing
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text:
One losing month doesn't mean your system is broken.

Here's the math that proves it.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text:
Most bettors see a rough 3-4 week stretch and conclude:
'This doesn't work.'

That's not analysis. That's recency bias.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text:
At a 54% win rate, you will still lose 4 or more bets in a row roughly 1 in 9 times.

Variance doesn't care about your confidence. It's just math.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text:
Real example:
100-bet sample at 54% win rate.
Expected wins: 54. Realistic range: 46–62.

That 46-win stretch isn't a broken system — it's a normal distribution.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text:
The edge shows up over hundreds of bets, not dozens.

Track everything. Resize if needed. Don't quit in the sample size that doesn't count yet.
ig_carousel_topic.caption: One bad month isn't a verdict — it's noise. Save this before the next losing streak hits and your brain starts lying to you.
